title: metadata: the artifact door's MemoryLoader keeps one item per (package, name), so a package body's second locale of an email template replaces the first
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYm8sWjp2Pk76warN7w

Child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527. Found by the #31699 dev in round 6 of PR #32214 (report 6801182598, out-of-scope finding 2, class a). It also happens on `main`, where the slot is keyed by name.

**Where:** `MemoryLoader.save`, the artifact door's in-memory loader in `packages/metadata`. Its slot holds one item per `(package, name)`.

**What happens:** a package body that ships two locales of one email template keeps only the last. Probe M1 at `f9f589da` answered `[[alpha, fr-FR]]` after saving `en-US` then `fr-FR`. `register` never persists there, so #32214 opens no new path to it.

**Do:**
1. Measure, after #32214 lands, whether an artifact carrying a two-locale email template serves both locales through the artifact door.
2. If one locale is lost, key the memory slot of a bundled type by `(package, name, member)`, as #32214 does for `DatabaseLoader`.
3. Pins:
   - both locales are served;
   - CONTROL: an unbundled type keeps one item per slot.

   Ablate once.

**Serial:** after #32214.
**Clause-②:** to be declared by the claimer.
**Business reason:** a package that ships a template in two languages silently serves one.

Dedupe (`MemoryLoader locale overwrite`, `memory slot member-blind`): none found.
